description: Sadakio is loyalty infrastructure for cafés and small businesses in Türkiye: guest registration, digital cards, stamps and points, QR codes, menus, visit events, webhooks and retention metrics over a REST API. This plugin lets ChatGPT search the Sadakio developer documentation in English and Turkish, read whole pages including ready-made solution recipes, list every endpoint of the Platform API and the Business API, and return the exact contract of an endpoint, so developers get correct integration code without guessing field names. It only reads public documentation and API contracts and never touches any business or guest data.

defaultPrompt: How do I register a guest and give a stamp with the Sadakio Platform API?
Show me the exact contract of the Sadakio visit event endpoint.
Build me a branded loyalty app for my client's café on Sadakio.
